name: RubyGems API
tagline: Official public API for RubyGems.org package registry data and gem metadata.
description: The RubyGems API provides programmatic access to the RubyGems.org package registry, including gem metadata, versions, dependencies, downloads, and search. Developers use it to query published gems, resolve versions, and integrate Ruby package information into tools and CI without scraping the website.

auth.details: API key (or OAuth) for write/authenticated endpoints; many read endpoints are public with no auth. Key via Authorization header or as query param depending on endpoint.

use_cases: look up gem metadata and latest version by name
list versions and dependencies for a Ruby gem
search gems by keyword for package discovery
check download counts or reverse dependencies
verify whether a gem version exists before install
